content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity but operate as walled gardens. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. All three restrict Nigerian creators due to payment processor dependencies, not their own policies. Crypto-native solutions like Coinbase Commerce or BitPay offer payment processing but require you to build or rent additional infrastructure for file delivery and order management. Self-hosted options like WordPress + WooCommerce give you ownership but demand technical maintenance and still rely on third-party plugins for crypto payments. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Blueprint provides complete, deployable stacks combining free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. You own the code, control the flow, and bypass platform restrictions entirely. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for deployment—but gain infrastructure sovereignty in return.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle exclude Nigeria not by choice but because Stripe and PayPal block the region. Their business model depends on these processors. Crypto gateways like NOWPayments or CoinGate work globally but leave you to build the surrounding infrastructure. Self-hosted solutions technically function anywhere but require you to source and integrate components yourself. COREMERCH’s stacks are designed for restricted markets, using tools that operate globally without geographic discrimination. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers serve your store from anywhere. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders without regional blocks. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, no buyer accounts, and a flat 0.5% fee. The architecture isn’t just neutral—it’s explicitly built for markets Stripe locked out.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal and Stripe charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction but reject Nigerian sellers outright. Gumroad adds its own 10% fee on top. Crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge 0.5% but require you to handle volatility (mitigated by instant settlements to stablecoins). Self-hosted solutions incur hosting, plugin, and maintenance costs. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Blueprint is a one-time $47 purchase. After deployment, your only recurring cost is the 0.5% payment processing fee. Transactions confirm on-chain within minutes, with webhooks automatically triggering file delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost advantage? You own the infrastructure after deployment—no subscriptions, no platform fees, no geographic restrictions.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own the code, control the flow, and operate without permission.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Gumroad own your customer data and can suspend your account without warning. Self-hosted solutions give you ownership but require constant maintenance. Crypto payment gateways handle transactions but leave automation to you. COREMERCH’s stacks automate the entire flow: payment verification via NOWPayments webhooks, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You own the source code, deploy it to your accounts, and retain full control. The system runs without COREMERCH’s involvement—we deliver the architecture, you own the operation. This isn’t a SaaS product; it’s sovereign infrastructure. Your store operates as long as GitHub, Cloudflare, and the blockchain function.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a temporary solution and can access PayPal/Stripe via a proxy, platforms like Gumroad work—until they don’t. For global crypto payments without building infrastructure, NOWPayments or CoinGate are viable but require you to piece together the rest. If you want full ownership but lack technical skills, self-hosted WordPress is an option—with ongoing maintenance costs. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Blueprint is for creators who want permanent, permissionless infrastructure. It’s a $47 investment in owning your stack, not renting it. Deploy in 48 hours, load your products, and operate without geographic or platform constraints. Choose this if you’re building a business, not a workaround.
